definition: ETAP-3 is a proprietary linguistic processing system focusing on English and Russian.
details: It was developed in Moscow, Russia at the Institute for Information Transmission Problems (ru:Институт проблем передачи информации им. А. А. Харкевича РАН). It is a rule-based system which uses the Meaning-Text Theory as its theoretical foundation. At present, there are several applications of ETAP-3, such as a machine translation tool, a converter of the Universal Networking Language, an interactive learning tool for Russian language learners and a syntactically annotated corpus of Russian language. Demo versions of some of these tools are available online.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Think of it this way: ETAP-3 is a proprietary linguistic processing system focusing on English and Russian. And here is the clever part: It was developed in Moscow, Russia at the Institute for Information Transmission Problems (ru:Институт проблем передачи информации им. А. А. Харкевича РАН). The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is ETAP-3 — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
